nodes.label: I01: Resolve technical choices
nodes.rationale: Pin compatible hashing/mail/photo dependencies and local image; record password, recent-auth, upload limits and storage decisions without changing product rules.

nodes.label: I02: Account persistence
nodes.rationale: Add forward migration for people/accounts/roles and explicit legacy links; preserve IDs and produce collision/reconciliation report without automatic claiming.

nodes.label: I03: Identity audit
nodes.rationale: Permit customer actors through a forward migration; sanitized identity events use the caller transaction and retain append-only protection.

nodes.label: I04: Password and bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Implement approved hashing and manual first-admin procedure; opt-in local-only testuser fixture never overwrites accounts or runs at startup.

nodes.label: I05: Session and delivery persistence
nodes.rationale: Migrate hashed sessions/action tokens/throttles/encrypted outbox; configure loopback Mailpit and validated env secrets.

nodes.label: I06: Login backend
nodes.rationale: Implement opaque sessions, fixed expiry, session-version checks, logout/all-device logout and generic failures; role/status checked server-side.

nodes.label: I07: Authenticated transport
nodes.rationale: Define DTOs and client mutations; integrate exact origins, credentials and CSRF/Origin validation including anonymous auth mutations.

nodes.label: I08: Customer login slice
nodes.rationale: Provide Spanish/English sign-in, Remember me and current-account/logout flow with shared accessible components.

nodes.label: I09: Management login slice
nodes.rationale: Reuse shared session controls and enforce management API/UI capabilities; keep public Foundation behavior working.
